{{Quote|Start the planetary rotation off right with a juicy, grilled-to-order nerfsteak, a breakfast staple from here to Outer Zznza and everywhere in between.|Dexter Jettster, menu for Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Outer Zznza''' was a location<ref name="Dex" /> in the [[Zznza system/Legends|Zznza system]], a part of the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA Zznza" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] claimed in the menu for [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on<ref name="Dex" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], that [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]] was a [[Diet/Legends|breakfast]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|staple]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including such locations as Coruscant and Outer Zznza.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Doctors on Outer Zznza advise:'' Cook Smapp over eliptical flame to reduce solar scars.|''The Galactic Gossip''|<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Monstersandaliens.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Outer Zznza was introduced in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas''.]]
Outer Zznza was first mentioned in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]]. In the book, an [[August 8 (in-universe)|August 8]], [[6094]] issue of the [[in-universe]] [[Galactic Gossip|''The Galactic Gossip'']] publication included an advisory statement from [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] on Outer Zznza that suggested the creatures known as [[Smapp]] should be cooked over [[Eliptical flame|elliptical flame]] in order to reduce the severity of [[solar scar]]s.<ref name="Monsters" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'' is [[Canon|non-canonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref>

In [[2009]], Outer Zznza was introduced into ''Star Wars'' Legends canon via "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive [[StarWars.com]] article that was written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="Dex" /> The 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Zznza [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Outer Zznza, in grid square S-14.<ref name="TEA Zznza" />
